style_header: A single die-cut glossy vinyl car sticker, flat vector illustration style with bold clean shapes and a thick white cut border all around, high contrast, centred, isolated on a perfectly flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow.
must_not: magenta or pink inside the sticker

items.prompt: A hunting saker falcon in flight with spread wings, side view, in gold, brown and cream with a black outline.
A traditional Kuwaiti wooden boom dhow sailing boat with two big white triangular sails on a stylised blue wave, side view.
The silhouette of the three Kuwait Towers in deep blue and teal with their sequinned spheres, in front of a big orange sunset circle.
Bold racing speed stripes in the Kuwait flag colours, green, white and red horizontal bands with a black trapezoid at the leading end, swept back like they are moving fast.
A traditional Arabic coffee pot dallah in polished brass gold next to a green palm tree, compact emblem.
A racing camel running fast with legs stretched, side view, sand gold with a black outline and motion lines.
